What's your return and refund policy?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Kajabi does not set a single return or refund policy for products sold on the platform. Each creator or business decides their own policy for their offers. 
If you buy a course, membership, or other product from a Kajabi site, you request a refund directly from that site owner. Use the contact details in your purchase confirmation email or the website’s Contact Us page. The creator manages billing and refunds.
If you are the creator selling products, you can issue refunds from your dashboard:
Go to Sales
Select Payments
Open Transactions
Find the payment
Click … (More Actions)
Choose Refund
Enter the refund amount and confirm 
There are no fees to process a refund, but the original transaction fees are not returned.
